objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: No Split-Path -Leaf or filename-only provenance matching exists.
provenance_match is true only for exact normalized absolute path membership.
Active-project membership does not automatically set provenance_match=true.
External candidate roots are independently scanned and correctly classified.
No candidate roots means no candidate-file scan.
Docs, schema, script, and Astra review packet are mutually consistent.
No destructive/system-modifying operations; stdout only; PENDING_ASTRA_REVIEW.
retry_reason: Final pre-Astra semantic correction: latest script still uses relative-path OR filename fallback for provenance matching and marks every active-project file provenance_match=true. That contradicts exact normalized path provenance semantics and the review packet.
orchestrator_corrections: Build a HashSet of exact normalized absolute provenance paths. For registry records with an absolute_path field, normalize that directly. For existing relative file fields, join them to ActiveProjectRoot and normalize. Never compare only file names and never compare a candidate-root-relative path to a repository-relative record.
Set provenance_match solely from exact normalized absolute-path membership in that HashSet. Being inside ActiveProjectRoot does NOT imply provenance_match=true.
KEEP_ACTIVE still takes precedence for any file inside ActiveProjectRoot, but evidence_source should be ACTIVE_PROJECT. provenance_match may independently be true or false.

For external files under explicit AgentOwnedCandidateRoots: if exact absolute provenance match -> CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY / EXACT_PROVENANCE_MATCH / provenance_match=true; otherwise -> CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY / EXPLICIT_AGENT_OWNED_ROOT / provenance_match=false.
Remove all filename-only fallback logic such as Split-Path -Leaf matching.
Keep candidate-root independent enumeration, overlap deduplication, boundary-safe containment, empty roots by default, stdout-only output, and zero destructive operations.

Correct documentation default-invocation wording: with no AgentOwnedCandidateRoots, the script should scan no candidate files; ActiveProjectRoot is a protected boundary and provenance-registry base, not recursively scanned by default.
The Astra review packet may claim exact provenance matching only if the implementation follows these rules.
